approach: Static translation of the 8088 code to native ARM64 through C (Apple Silicon), x86-64 NASM (other desktop targets), and C/WebAssembly (browser), emulated PC hardware, SDL2 front end
notes: Apple Silicon fork of petarov/alleycat.exe; original history, licence and credits preserved. Native ARM64 build and packaging by RetroShopPT. Builds need the original CAT.EXE, which is not included in source control. The upstream port is largely LLM-generated.
